draw_context: *draw.Context(...), which an app gets from cx.drawing()

draw_types.name: draw.Box
draw_types.doc: Rounded rectangle with an optional border.

draw_types.name: draw.Surface
draw_types.doc: A rounded rect with one gradient, a rim-lit border, and a soft shadow, and its look (`draw/types.zig`, section 6).

fields.name: rect
fields.doc: The shape grown by `reach(shadow)` on every side.

fields.name: gradient
fields.doc: Linear: from.xy, to.xy; radial: center.xy, radius.xy; in the shape's uv.

fields.name: shadow
fields.doc: Offset x, offset y, blur, alpha.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: 0 linear, 1 radial.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where the arc begins, a fraction of `theme.arc_sweep` from `theme.arc_start`; with `sweep` it ends at `start + sweep`, at most 1.

draw_types.name: draw.Glyph
draw_types.doc: One glyph quad sampled from the glyph atlas (texture 0), written by `text.place`.

draw_types.name: draw.Image
draw_types.doc: A textured quad sampled from an `rgba8` texture and multiplied by `tint`.

draw_types.name: draw.Path
draw_types.doc: One chunk of a stroked path: at most `path.chunk_points_max` points of the context's point buffer, drawn with round caps.

fields.name: anchor_x
fields.doc: The path origin minus `rect.xy`: points are stored relative to that origin, so a shift of `rect.xy` moves the stroke with it.

fields.name: hover
fields.doc: Mix weight toward `theme.lighten`.

fields.name: prev
fields.doc: 1 when an earlier chunk shares this chunk's first point, else 0.

fields.name: next
fields.doc: 1 when a later chunk shares this chunk's last point, else 0.

draw_types.name: draw.Fill
draw_types.doc: A filled band of a shape from the point pool.

fields.name: rect
fields.doc: The band's bounds, padded by `aa_pad` on x and at the shape's outer top and bottom only.

fields.name: anchor_x
fields.doc: `origin - rect.xy` (section 5).

fields.name: point_count
fields.doc: Twice the band's segments.

fields.name: rule
fields.doc: 0 non-zero, 1 even-odd.

fields.name: hover
fields.doc: The mix toward `theme.lighten`.

draw_types.name: draw.Waveform
draw_types.doc: A min/max band per column from the point pool.

fields.name: stride
fields.doc: 1: `(min, max)` per column; 2: then `(-rms, rms)`.

fields.name: bias
fields.doc: Subtracted from every channel after the opacity (section 3); 0 for a plain composite.

draw_types.name: draw.Glass
draw_types.doc: A rounded rect over a backdrop's pack (section 5).

fields.name: look
fields.doc: Radius, frost, saturation, rim.

fields.name: lens
fields.doc: Refraction, bevel, rim width, unused.

draw_types.name: draw.Blur
draw_types.doc: One direction of a separable Gaussian over a target (section 4).

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: One texel along the blur, in uv, in `xy`; `z` is the radius in taps; `w` unused.

types.name: draw.ArcLook
types.doc: How an `Arc` looks (`Arc.of`).

fields.name: sweep
fields.doc: The fraction of `theme.arc_sweep` drawn, `[0, 1]`.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Where it begins, a fraction of `theme.arc_sweep`; `start + sweep` is at most 1.

fields.name: hover
fields.doc: Mix weight toward `theme.lighten`, `[0, 1]`.

types.name: draw.Backdrop
types.doc: A marked layer this frame: its layer, its blur sigma in logical pixels, and the id its glass samples (section 1).

types.name: draw.Batch
types.doc: One draw call: `count` instances of type `type_id` starting at `first` in its pool.

fields.name: texture
fields.doc: The texture of a textured type's batch, else `TextureId.atlas` (unused).

types.name: draw.BatchOrder
types.doc: How a layer's batches order (`draw/pools.zig`, section 1).

types.name: draw.BoxLook
types.doc: `Box.of`'s look and `Arc.of`'s (`draw/types.zig`, section 5).

fields.name: hover
fields.doc: Mix weight toward `theme.lighten`, `[0, 1]`; widgets pass an animator times `widgets.hover_lighten`.

fields.name: down
fields.doc: Mix weight toward `theme.darken`, `[0, 1]`, applied after the hover mix.

types.name: draw.Clip
types.doc: Exclusive-max clip in logical pixels, copied into every instance's `clip`.

types.name: draw.DrawType
types.doc: One registered draw type and the instances its pool holds per frame.

types.name: draw.GlassLook
types.doc: How a `Glass` looks (`Glass.of`, section 5).

fields.name: tint
fields.doc: Straight RGBA; its alpha is how far the backdrop moves toward its colour.

fields.name: frost
fields.doc: 0 reads the light level, 1 the blurred one.

fields.name: saturation
fields.doc: 1 unchanged, 0 grey, above 1 more vivid; at most `saturation_max`.

fields.name: rim
fields.doc: `[0, 1]`: how far the rim and the bevel move toward `theme.lighten`.

fields.name: rim_width
fields.doc: The lit ring's width at the outline, logical pixels.

fields.name: refraction
fields.doc: How far the outline bends the backdrop toward the centre, logical pixels.

fields.name: bevel
fields.doc: The width of the bending band inside the outline, logical pixels.

types.name: draw.Gradient
types.doc: A surface's gradient, in the shape's own uv (0 to 1 across it): a line `from` to `to`, or an ellipse of `radius` about `center` (module guide, section 6).

types.name: draw.Inset
types.doc: Independent insets in UI logical pixels: container padding and child margins.

types.name: draw.Layer
types.doc: A draw layer, 0 to `layer_count - 1` (7), where an unnamed one is written by its number, as `@fromBackingInt(2)` for layer 2 (`@enumFromInt` also compiles).

types.name: draw.Range
types.doc: A record range `[first, end)` to upload; `end > first`.

types.name: draw.Rect
types.doc: Axis-aligned box in UI logical pixels.

types.name: draw.Shadow
types.doc: A surface's black shadow: moved by `offset`, blurred by `blur` (a Gaussian of sigma `blur / 2`, 0 for a hard edge), at most `alpha` dark.

types.name: draw.SurfaceLook
types.doc: How a `Surface` looks (`Surface.of`).

fields.name: fill
fields.doc: The gradient's start, straight RGBA; alone, a flat fill.

fields.name: fill_to
fields.doc: The gradient's end; null is `fill`.

fields.name: rim
fields.doc: Mix weight of the border toward `theme.lighten` along the top edge, fading to 0 at the bottom, `[0, 1]`.

types.name: draw.Transform
types.doc: A 2 x 3 affine map of the plane, `+y` down (module guide, section 2a).

fields.name: a
fields.doc: `x' = a x + c y + tx`, `y' = b x + d y + ty`.

types.name: draw.View
types.doc: A layer's pan/zoom view (`draw/pools.zig`, section 5c).

types.name: draw.fill.Band
types.doc: One band of a plan: `[top, bottom)` in the shape's absolute y, listing `count` segments.

types.name: draw.fill.Builder
types.doc: Flattened closed contours (module guide, section 2).

fields.name: overflowed
fields.doc: A segment did not fit, so `append` refuses this shape.

fields.name: zoom
fields.doc: Screen pixels per logical pixel: `cx.view_zoom` inside a canvas, 1 elsewhere.

fields.name: transform
fields.doc: Applied to every point a call takes (module guide, section 2a).

types.name: draw.fill.Edge
types.doc: One straight piece of a contour, in the Builder's absolute coordinates.

types.name: draw.fill.Placed
types.doc: Where a shape went: `count` points from `first`, relative to the top-left of `bounds` (absolute, unpadded), in `bands` instances.

types.name: draw.fill.Plan
types.doc: A shape's bands, top to bottom (module guide, section 3).

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Points the bands take: 2 per segment per band it meets.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: The unpadded bounds of the edges.

types.name: draw.fill.Rule
types.doc: Which regions of the winding are inside.

types.name: draw.fill.Style
types.doc: How a shape is filled.

types.name: draw.path.Placed
types.doc: Where a path's points went: `count` points from `first` in the point pool, relative to the top-left of `bounds` (absolute, unpadded).

types.name: draw.path.Stroke
types.doc: Color, width in logical pixels, and the hover mix toward `theme.lighten`.

aliases.name: draw.Point
aliases.doc: One path point in logical pixels, relative to its path's origin (`draw/path.zig`).

constants.name: draw.layer_count
constants.doc: Layers per frame.

constants.name: draw.transparent
constants.doc: A color with zero alpha: a `Box` with no border.

constants.name: draw.point_cap_max
constants.doc: Largest `App.config.point_cap`: point indices stay exact as `f32` instance fields.

constants.name: draw.vertex_count
constants.doc: Vertices in the unit quad drawn as a triangle list.

constants.name: draw.quad_bytes
constants.doc: Byte size of the unit quad vertex buffer.

constants.name: draw.matrix_bytes
constants.doc: Byte size of one `mat4x4<f32>`.

constants.name: draw.time_bytes
constants.doc: Byte size of the frame uniform's time slot, one `vec4<f32>` whose `x` is the animation time in seconds (`animator.Time`).

constants.name: draw.time_offset
constants.doc: Offset of the time slot: right after the projection, so it does not move with the theme.

constants.name: draw.theme_offset
constants.doc: Offset of `theme.Theme` in the frame uniform.

constants.name: draw.uniform_bytes
constants.doc: Byte size of the frame uniform: the projection matrix, the time slot, and `theme.Theme`.

constants.name: draw.unit_quad
constants.doc: Two triangles covering the unit square, as flat `[x, y]` pairs drawn as a triangle list without an index buffer.

constants.name: draw.upload_range_cap
constants.doc: Ranges one pool upload may write (module guide, section 5).

constants.name: draw.merge_gap
constants.doc: Unchanged records a range may bridge: a gap this short costs less to write than another op.

constants.name: draw.path.segments_min
constants.doc: Segments of a flattened cubic: at least `segments_min`, at most `segments_max`.

constants.name: draw.path.flatten_px
constants.doc: Target segment length of a flattened cubic, in logical pixels.

constants.name: draw.path.cubic_points_max
constants.doc: Points of the longest flattened cubic.

constants.name: draw.path.chunk_points_max
constants.doc: Points and segments of one chunk (section 4).

constants.name: draw.path.chunk_area_max
constants.doc: Padded chunk bounds, in square logical pixels, past which a chunk of at least `chunk_segments_min` segments stops growing.

constants.name: draw.path.aa_pad
constants.doc: Padding past the half width that holds the antialiased edge (section 5).

constants.name: draw.path.seam_tie
constants.doc: Seam distances closer than this, in logical pixels, are a tie, which the side of the seam decides (section 4a).

constants.name: draw.path.seam_bias
constants.doc: Within a tie the earlier chunk keeps a fragment whose `seam_side` is at most this many logical pixels: a line off the bisector, because a symmetric shape puts whole rows of pixel centres on the bisector itself (section 4a).

constants.name: draw.path.hit_slop
constants.doc: Hit distance past the half width (section 6).

constants.name: draw.path.plot_samples_max
constants.doc: Samples `plot` takes at most.

constants.name: draw.path.polygon_points_max
constants.doc: Points `polygon` takes at most.

constants.name: draw.fill.segments_max
constants.doc: Segments one band lists: no glyph from U+0021 to U+017F is refused at this cap in six faces from 16 to 2,000 px (measured on the step page).

constants.name: draw.fill.segment_cap
constants.doc: Segments one `Builder` holds: the longest of those glyphs flattens to 380.

constants.name: draw.fill.bands_max
constants.doc: Most bands one shape makes.

constants.name: draw.fill.band_height_min
constants.doc: A band this tall or less is not split: logical pixels.

constants.name: draw.fill.band_grid
constants.doc: Band edges are multiples of `1 / band_grid` logical pixels (section 3).

constants.name: draw.fill.aa_pad
constants.doc: Padding that holds the antialiased edge, as `path.aa_pad`.

constants.name: draw.fill.tolerance_px
constants.doc: Flattening tolerance of a `Builder`, in device pixels: a quarter of `raster.tolerance_px`, which keeps chords of a glyph facet-free at 2,000 px with no shape refused.

functions.name: draw.Registry
functions.doc: The comptime tables for one app's draw types.

functions.name: draw.Context
functions.doc: The draw context for one app: `App.draw` receives a pointer to it.

functions.name: draw.Ring
functions.doc: A ring texture view (module guide, section 4).

functions.name: draw.sdf_box
functions.doc: Signed distance of a rounded rectangle, negative inside and positive outside.

functions.name: draw.erf
functions.doc: The error function, Abramowitz and Stegun 7.1.26 (error below 1.5e-7).

functions.name: draw.gradient_t
functions.doc: Where `(u, v)` of a shape falls on `gradient`, in `[0, 1]`.

functions.name: draw.mix_premultiplied
functions.doc: `a` to `b` at `t`, mixed premultiplied and returned straight, so a fade to a transparent stop keeps its colour.

functions.name: draw.shadow_alpha
functions.doc: A soft shadow's alpha at signed distance `dist` from its (offset) shape, before the shape masks it.

functions.name: draw.sdf_segment
functions.doc: Distance from `(px, py)` to the segment from `(ax, ay)` to `(bx, by)`.

functions.name: draw.sdf_arc
functions.doc: Signed distance of an open ring.

functions.name: draw.contains_box
functions.doc: True when `(px, py)` lies inside the rounded rectangle, boundary included.

functions.name: draw.check_type
functions.doc: Null when a type satisfies the draw type convention, else a message naming it.

functions.name: draw.type_source
functions.doc: The assembled WGSL module of a draw type, for tests of app-defined types.

functions.name: draw.dirty_ranges
functions.doc: The ranges to upload so that every record of `new` that differs from `old` at the same index, and every record past `old.len`, is written: the runs of such records in order, a run starting at most `merge_gap` records after the previous range joining it, and once `upload_range_cap` ranges exist the last one growing to cover the rest.

functions.name: draw.dirty_range
functions.doc: The smallest range covering every record `dirty_ranges` writes, or null when there is none.

functions.name: draw.covered_glyphs
functions.doc: Glyphs an opaque box in a later batch of the same layer covers.

functions.name: draw.ortho_y_down
functions.doc: Writes the column-major projection from top-left, Y-down logical pixels to WebGPU NDC for a `width_px` by `height_px` framebuffer at `scale_120`.

functions.name: draw.view_ortho
functions.doc: Writes the projection of a layer drawn through `view`: `ortho · T`, where `T` maps world points to logical screen points (`View.apply`).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).init
functions.doc: Empties every pool and the glyph cache and creates the glyph atlas as texture 0.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).reset
functions.doc: Empties every pool, returns to the base layer, and starts the glyph cache's frame (`Cache.begin_frame`).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).offscreen
functions.doc: Draws `layer` into the offscreen `target` this frame, covering the logical `rect` (x, y, width, height): its instances render in the target's pass, not the main pass (`draw/fx.zig`).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).backdrop
functions.doc: Marks `layer_value` as a backdrop this frame (section 5d) with a blur of sigma `blur` logical pixels, and returns the id its glass samples.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).backdrop_under
functions.doc: The backdrop a glass on `layer_value` samples: the highest one marked at or below it this frame, or null (section 5d).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).backdrop_list
functions.doc: This frame's backdrops, in call order.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).binding_of
functions.doc: The binding of `layer_index` this frame, or null when it draws to the main pass.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).view
functions.doc: Gives `layer_value` the pan/zoom `next` for this frame (section 5c).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).view_of
functions.doc: The view of `layer_index` this frame, or null when it has none.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).open_views
functions.doc: Opens a canvas over the viewed layers `mask` at `zoom` (section 5c).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).close_views
functions.doc: Closes the open canvas.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).binding_list
functions.doc: This frame's offscreen bindings.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).layer
functions.doc: Sets the layer later appends go to and returns the previous one, so a widget can restore it with `defer _ = cx.layer(previous);`.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).append
functions.doc: Appends `instance` to `T`'s pool on the current layer.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).room
functions.doc: Instances `T`'s pool can still take this frame.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).refuse
functions.doc: Counts an instance a caller refused before appending it, such as a path whose chunks would not fit (`draw/path.zig`).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).reserve_points
functions.doc: Reserves `count` points and returns the index of the first, or null (counted in `overflow_count`) when the pool cannot hold them.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).release_points
functions.doc: Takes back the reservation that started at `first`, which must be the last one.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).point_items
functions.doc: This frame's points, in reservation order.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).items
functions.doc: The live instances of `T`, in pool order (key order after `finalize`).

functions.name: draw.Context(...).revision
functions.doc: The revision of `T`'s pool; it moves on every `reset` and `append`.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).layer_at
functions.doc: The layer of `T`'s instance at `index`.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).counts
functions.doc: The instance count of every pool, indexed by type id.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).shift
functions.doc: Adds `(dx, dy)` to `rect.xy` of every instance appended since `starts` (from `counts`), in every pool and on every layer.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).batch_list
functions.doc: The batches `finalize` formed, in draw order.

functions.name: draw.Context(...).finalize
functions.doc: Sorts each pool by key when needed and forms the batches.

functions.name: draw.Box.of
functions.doc: The box over `rect`, clipped to `clip`, looking like `look` (module guide, section 5).

functions.name: draw.Arc.of
functions.doc: The ring inscribed in the square `ring`, clipped to `clip`, looking like `look` (module guide, section 5).

functions.name: draw.Surface.reach
functions.doc: How far a shadow reaches past its shape on every side, in logical pixels.

functions.name: draw.Surface.of
functions.doc: The surface whose shape is `rect`, clipped to `clip`, looking like `look` (module guide, section 6).

functions.name: draw.Glass.of
functions.doc: The glass over `rect`, clipped to `clip`, looking like `look` (section 5).

functions.name: draw.path.chunks_max
functions.doc: Most chunks a path of `point_count` points makes (section 4).

functions.name: draw.path.cubic_segments
functions.doc: Segments a cubic flattens to (section 3).

functions.name: draw.path.cubic_segments_at
functions.doc: Segments a cubic drawn at `zoom` screen pixels per pixel flattens to: by its on-screen length (section 3).

functions.name: draw.path.flatten_cubic
functions.doc: Writes the flattened cubic into `out` and returns its point count, `cubic_segments + 1`.

functions.name: draw.path.flatten_cubic_at
functions.doc: `flatten_cubic` for a cubic drawn at `zoom` (`cubic_segments_at`).

functions.name: draw.path.plot_points
functions.doc: Maps `samples` into `rect` with `range = .{ lo, hi }` (section 3); one point per sample.

functions.name: draw.path.chunk_end
functions.doc: The last point index of the chunk that starts at `start` (section 4).

functions.name: draw.path.chunk_count
functions.doc: The chunks `points` split into for a stroke of `width`.

functions.name: draw.path.distance_to_polyline
functions.doc: Distance from `(x, y)` to the polyline through `points` (one point is a dot).

functions.name: draw.path.oriented_quad
functions.doc: The corners of the quad `types.Path.vertex` rasterizes for a chunk through `points`, in the points' coordinates, in the order (t_lo, n_lo), (t_hi, n_lo), (t_hi, n_hi), (t_lo, n_hi) (section 5a).

functions.name: draw.path.quad_contains
functions.doc: True when `p` is inside the convex quad `corners` (either winding), edges included.

functions.name: draw.path.chunk_alpha
functions.doc: The alpha the `Path` shader writes at `(x, y)` (absolute, logical pixels) for `chunk`, with `points` the frame's whole point buffer and `pixel_size` the logical size of one device pixel.

functions.name: draw.path.seam_side
functions.doc: The signed distance from `q` to the line through `b` that splits a tie at the seam between the segments a-b and b-c: negative on a-b's side, positive on b-c's.

functions.name: draw.path.polyline
functions.doc: Appends the stroke through `points` (absolute, at least two) to the draw context `cx` on its current layer.

functions.name: draw.path.polyline_at
functions.doc: Appends the stroke through `points` like `polyline`, but stores the points relative to `origin` instead of their bounds' top-left (section 5).

functions.name: draw.path.cubic
functions.doc: Flattens the cubic by its on-screen length (at the open canvas's zoom, `cx.view_zoom`) and appends it as `polyline` does.

functions.name: draw.path.plot
functions.doc: Plots `samples` into `rect` over `range` (section 3) and appends it as `polyline` does.

functions.name: draw.path.polygon
functions.doc: Appends the closed stroke through `points` (absolute, at least three) as `polyline` does, joining the last point to the first with the seam rule (section 4).

functions.name: draw.fill.plan_bands
functions.doc: Cuts `edges` into bands (module guide, section 3).

functions.name: draw.fill.append
functions.doc: Appends the shape in `shape`, closing an open contour, to the draw context `cx` on its current layer.

functions.name: draw.fill.signed_area
functions.doc: The signed part of a pixel left of the segment from `a` to `b`, in that pixel's rows, with coordinates in pixels from its centre (module guide, section 4).

functions.name: draw.fill.cover_of
functions.doc: Coverage from a pixel's summed signed area, by `rule` (module guide, section 4).

functions.name: draw.fill.coverage
functions.doc: The coverage of the pixel centred at `(x, y)`, `pixel_size` logical pixels wide, by the whole shape, with no bands: what every band's list must agree with.

functions.name: draw.fill.band_alpha
functions.doc: The alpha the `Fill` shader writes at `(x, y)` (absolute, logical pixels) for `band`, with `points` the frame's whole point buffer.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.init
functions.doc: An empty Builder whose chords suit `zoom` screen pixels per logical pixel: pass `cx.drawing().text.device_scale()` (the display scale times the canvas zoom).

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.reset
functions.doc: Empties the Builder to build again at the same zoom, with the identity transform.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.set_transform
functions.doc: Sets the transform for the contours that follow.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.move_to
functions.doc: Begins a contour at `point`, closing the one before.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.line_to
functions.doc: A straight segment from the pen to `point`.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.quad_to
functions.doc: A quadratic from the pen through `control` to `end`.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.cubic_to
functions.doc: A cubic from the pen through `control` to `end`.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.close
functions.doc: Closes the open contour with a line to its start, if one is open.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.polygon
functions.doc: A closed polygon through `points`, as its own contour.

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.outline
functions.doc: Adds every contour of `outline` at `scale` pixels per font unit with the pen at `pen`, `+y` down (module guide, section 2).

functions.name: draw.fill.Builder.items
functions.doc: The contours so far, closed or not.

functions.name: draw.Transform.translation
functions.doc: Moves every point by `x`, `y`.

functions.name: draw.Transform.scaling
functions.doc: Scales about the origin by `sx` across and `sy` down.

functions.name: draw.Transform.rotation
functions.doc: Positive turns clockwise on screen, with `+y` down.

functions.name: draw.Transform.then
functions.doc: `first`, then `second` on its result.

functions.name: draw.Transform.around
functions.doc: `inner` with `pivot` held still.

functions.name: draw.Transform.apply
functions.doc: `point` mapped by the transform.
